claimed_scope: Build the smallest deterministic, persistence-agnostic GoalContract lifecycle for explicit caller-supplied goal candidates and bounded lifecycle transitions. The component may validate, freeze, fingerprint and purely transition goal records under exact goal identity, generation and state-digest fences; preserve parent/source/provenance lineage; distinguish proposal/trial/active/dormant/retired states; and require explicit external evidence references for any promotion. It must not infer or self-generate world facts, grant effect authority, call providers/tools, evaluate wake conditions, choose Persistent Pulse actions, mark executor DONE as verified completion, or bypass CompletionGate/EffectGate. Source plus deterministic tests and public repository CI only; no UnifiedDB persistence, VPS, physical GRID10 or whole-system credit.
